design_metadata.phasing_concept_zh: 近—中—远三期渐进式实施，围绕京张主轴自中向南、再向北滚动生长。
design_metadata.phasing_concept_en: Progressive near-, mid- and long-term implementation, growing along the Jing-Zhang spine from the center outward.

phases.focus_zh: 原点·共生坊启动区：京张主轴首段贯通、首批15分钟AI服务圈节点落地、人-AI共生示范区试点
phases.focus_en: Origin Symbiosis Hub start zone: first segment of the Jing-Zhang spine, first 15-minute AI service circle nodes, human-AI symbiosis pilot

phases.focus_zh: 众智·进化园加速成型：双螺旋北翼产业与绿廊成型、清河滨水带贯通、AI全栈创新链集聚
phases.focus_en: Zhongzhi Evolution Park takes shape: northern helix wing industry and green corridor, Qinghe waterfront link-up, full-stack AI innovation chain

phases.focus_zh: 星桥·对话港整体提升：南部门户对话接口建成、全域双螺旋结构与AI服务圈网络化
phases.focus_en: StarBridge Dialogue Port uplift: southern dialogue interface completed, district-wide double helix and AI service circle network

properties.phase_focus_zh: 原点·共生坊核心启动：京张主轴首段贯通、星桥天线塔广场与首批15分钟AI服务圈节点落地
properties.phase_focus_en: Origin Symbiosis Hub core kick-off: first Jing-Zhang spine segment, StarBridge Antenna Spire plaza, and first AI service circle nodes
properties.design_role_zh: 以原点·共生坊为近期启动核心，示范人-AI共生生活方式
properties.design_role_en: The Symbiosis Hub leads the near-term phase as the human-AI symbiosis demonstration core

properties.phase_focus_zh: 众智·进化园加速成型：双螺旋北翼产业与绿廊成型、清河滨水带贯通、AI全栈创新链集聚
properties.phase_focus_en: Zhongzhi Evolution Park acceleration: northern helix wing industry and green corridor, Qinghe waterfront link-up, full-stack AI innovation chain
properties.design_role_zh: 以众智·进化园为中期增长极，向北延展双螺旋北翼
properties.design_role_en: The Evolution Park drives the mid-term phase, extending the northern helix wing northward

properties.phase_focus_zh: 星桥·对话港整体提升：南部门户对话接口建成、全域双螺旋结构与AI服务圈网络化
properties.phase_focus_en: StarBridge Dialogue Port uplift: southern dialogue interface completed, district-wide double helix and AI service circle network
properties.design_role_zh: 以星桥·对话港为远期门户，完成双螺旋南翼与全域对话接口
properties.design_role_en: The Dialogue Port completes the southern helix wing and the district-wide dialogue interface
